caseNameFull: Weinberger, Secretary of Defense v. Ramirez de Arellano

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded to the Court of Appeals for reconsideration of its opinion and judgment in light of the Foreign Assistance and Related Programs Appropriations Act for fiscal year 1985, Pub. L. 98-473, 98 Stat. 1884, 1893-1894, and other events occurring since October 5, 1984.
